forecast_assumptions_retained.central_demand_method: Round historical 34/13 reviews, 8/13 cheap repairs and 2/13 strong repairs per attempted milestone over 24 offered milestones. This assumes all stages are reached; a bounded stop may cost less while failing the intended completion objective.
forecast_assumptions_retained.controller_context: Retained repair aliases and feedback can enlarge review context. The rehearsal reaches six candidate aliases and a 218,274-byte API payload. Live generated source/evidence may differ.
forecast_assumptions_retained.historical_basis: 143 actual retained benchmark calls, priced usage $10.038937. Use the eight four-candidate trajectories and 13 attempted milestones for matched role demand; exclude strong-anchor means and correct milestone weighting for a full 24-milestone scenario.
forecast_assumptions_retained.input_tokens: Central sensitivity assumes 50–75% of stage-weighted historical input tokens. Complete scripted payload measurements qualitatively support smaller context but are bytes, not tokenizer counts; do not directly substitute their ratios for live token multipliers.
forecast_assumptions_retained.output_tokens: Central scenarios use unchanged historical mean outputs at low reasoning. Stress scenarios scale means up to 2x; every role/stage mean remains within the 12,288-token output ceiling. No output length probability is calibrated.
forecast_assumptions_retained.physical_setup: Four blocks share first-milestone independent A/B setup and all-three-arm scouts once. Full24-milestone initial builders 80 and scouts 32. Later stages follow arm-specific source. No double-counting imports.
forecast_assumptions_retained.uncertainty: The working band and stress scenarios are planning assumptions, not confidence intervals or guarantees. No inference of future call demand is made from the forced 228-call rehearsal trace.

funding_proposal.certificate_boundary: The passing certificate binds the current $50 plan with live_enabled=false. It is not an $80 funding approval or proof for a differently hashed future plan. If funding/configuration changes the frozen contract, root must satisfy the applicable exact-contract qualification/rehearsal/audit gates before any paid dispatch.
funding_proposal.not_guaranteed: Neither $80 nor a passing scripted audit guarantees maximal-token funding, live project acceptance or complete cohort execution. The conservative $711.497856 full-context envelope is not a forecast and is not the requested allowance.
funding_proposal.rationale: The $80 ceiling protects a complete demanding pilot better than the existing cap. The modeled full 256-call retained-pool/doubled-output case uses $32.340258, plus $5.526480 reservation headroom, leaving about $6.59 under the proposed $44.456374 available allowance. A $70 cumulative ceiling falls short of that same planning commitment by about $3.41 and barely misses the 1.5x-output case. The recommendation is contingency capacity, not a target to consume.
funding_proposal.scope_if_approved: The registered twelve-trajectory, two-domain continuation pilot, subject to its exact execution gates and cumulative accounting cap. Not blanket authorization for unrelated future studies.
funding_proposal.suggested_user_question: The full scripted pilot and independent audit passed. May I raise the cumulative API budget from $50 to $80 (an additional $30) and run the registered 12-trajectory live pilot after its funded execution gates are satisfied? Expected new usage is about $10–13; the higher ceiling covers demanding repairs and reservation headroom and does not guarantee completion.

independent_read_only_sanity_review.result: Official audit/comparator and their principal bindings agree; model/call/price/reservation assumptions remain unchanged. The $80 contingency remains reasonable but unapproved; the $50 certificate does not authorize the proposed contract.

next_action: Root may present the concrete funding choice to the user. Until an applicable approval exists and the funded contract satisfies its exact gates, preserve the $50 cap and keep live dispatch disabled.

purpose: Bind the budget recommendation to the corrected official rehearsal/audit and prepare a concrete prospective funding decision. Preserve the original forecast and failed-audit-run diagnostic.

reservation_headroom.allowance_heuristic: Estimated total charges plus one full strong reservation supplies conservative late-call planning headroom for the phased schedule. It is not an exact measured peak or a provider invoice.
reservation_headroom.balance_source: Bound root accounting reconciliation, reconfirmed in root task instruction. This review did not open the ledger.
reservation_headroom.historical_peak_limit: The official audit relies on qualified transactional admission guards and explicitly does not independently reconstruct actual historical reservation-time peaks.
reservation_headroom.meaning: A further strong request must fit its full reservation before dispatch. With the current recorded balance, prior settled/reserved study usage above $8.929894 prevents that next strong call. The last admitted call may settle above this threshold, so it is not an absolute cash-spend limit.
